task: ADVFRONT Given the number 100, compute the sum of all prime numbers less than 50, then multiply that by the count of prime numbers between 50 and 100; store the result via (rlm-set answer ...) then (rlm-set Final true). Solve this by delegating one part via (sub-rlm ~~QT~~sum of primes less than 50~~QT~~) and combining.
lesson: Today I learned `prime?`'s `dotimes` loop argument order was reversed, causing it to check `(+ i 2)` instead of `i`.
